name: depth-text
title: Depth Text
description: A single word built from dozens of stacked copies: a bright white face with a thick pale purple side behind it. It turns slowly on its own and leans with the pointer.
use: A single large word in a hero or title slide that needs weight and a sense of dimension.
avoid: Only a few characters fit at this size, and at the widest angle the layers smear into a slab.
a11y: Depth copies are hidden from screen readers and the face stays plain readable text; reduced motion stills the orbit and tilt. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: The word fills the stage in very heavy white sans-serif with tight spacing, edge lit against near-black. Behind the face, many faint lavender copies offset upward and to the side build a deep solid wall, grounded by a soft purple shadow.
behaves: The word orbits slowly in perspective, so the purple side sweeps from one edge to the other. Moving the pointer tips the whole block toward or away from the cursor, and releasing leaves it to its slow drift again.
customise: Set the word with text, then tune layers, depth, face and depth colours, tilt, perspective, orbit speed, font size and weight. Gradient depth, outline, float and hover push switch extra looks on.
weight: moderate: Thirty-four stacked text copies sharing a few 3D transforms, animated every frame while orbiting.
issues: At the widest angle the stacked copies merge into one slab and the word briefly stops reading.
polishWhy: Crisp geometry and a smooth tilt; the deep stack smears letter shapes at full rotation.
